title: Advancing subseasonal forecasting with machine learning
title_zh: 利用机器学习提升亚季节预报能力
abstract: Decision-makers rely on weather forecasts to plant crops, manage wildfires, allocate water and energy and prepare for weather extremes1-3. Today, such forecasts enjoy unprecedented accuracy as far as 2 weeks thanks to steady advances in physics-based dynamical models and data-driven artificial intelligence models4-10. However, model skill drops precipitously at subseasonal timescales (2-6 weeks ahead) due to compounding errors, systemic model biases and the chaotic nature of the atmosphere11-15. To counter this degradation, we introduce probabilistic bias correction, a machine learning framework that substantially reduces systematic error by learning to correct historical probabilistic forecasts. When applied to the leading dynamical and artificial intelligence models from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), probabilistic bias correction doubles the modest subseasonal skill of the AI Forecasting System16 and improves the skill of the operationally debiased dynamical model17 for 91% of pressure, 92% of temperature and 98% of precipitation targets. We designed probabilistic bias correction for operational deployment, and, in the 2025 real-time forecasting competition of ECMWF18, its global forecasts were the best for all weather variables and lead times, outperforming the dynamical models from six operational forecasting centres, an international dynamical multimodel ensemble, the AI Forecasting System of ECMWF and the forecasting systems of 34 teams worldwide. These probabilistic skill gains translate into more accurate prediction of extreme events and have the potential to improve agricultural planning, energy management and disaster preparedness in vulnerable communities19.
abstract_zh: 决策者依靠天气预报来种植农作物、管理山火、分配水能资源并为极端天气做准备1-3。如今，得益于基于物理的动力学模型和数据驱动的智能模型的不断进步，此类预报的精度已达到前所未有的水平，可延伸至两周以内4-10。然而，随着预报时延延伸至亚季节尺度（提前2-6周），模型技能会因累积误差、系统性模型偏差和大气的混沌本质而急剧下降11-15。为对抗这种技能退化，我们引入了一种机器学习框架——概率偏差修正，该框架通过学习修正历史概率预报，从而大幅降低系统误差。当应用于欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）领先的动力学模型和智能模型时，概率偏差修正将AI预报系统16亚季节的有限技能翻了两番，并显著提升了运行中去偏的动力学模型17在气压、温度和降水目标上的技能：分别覆盖了91%的气压、92%的温度和98%的降水目标。我们将概率偏差修正设计为可运行部署，在2025年ECMWF实时预报竞赛18中，其全球预报在所有天气变量和预报时限上均表现最佳，超过了来自六个运营预报中心的动力学模型、一个国际动力学多模型集合、ECMWF的AI预报系统以及全球34支队伍的预报系统。这些概率技能的提升转化为极端天气事件更准确的预测，有望改善脆弱社区的农业规划、能源管理和灾害准备工作19。
